title: Smooth cutoff equal to 1 near a compact set, supported in an open set
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ and all sets K, N ⊆ ℝ^P with K compact, N open and K ⊆ N, there exist a C¹ function ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ N, and an open set V ⊆ ℝ^P with K ⊆ V such that ζ(y) = 1 for every y ∈ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K N : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → IsOpen N → K ⊆ N → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ HasCompactSupport ζ ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ N ∧ ∃ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, ζ y = 1
